reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.comment: For the price, you get great value. The case is easy to build in and there is a good amount of room despite being M-ATX. Only complaint is that I wish there was an intake fan pre-installed somewhere but otherwise it is wonderful.
reviews.author: Joseph

reviews.title: Best Buy for your Dollar
reviews.comment: It fits- everything... Give it a try! It doesn't matter what size cooler or GPU you are running- this puppy can hold it, in style! I love it's simplicity and brutalist aesthetic. I'll be order 4 more since I'll be running a streaming setup for my 4 kids.
reviews.author: IVANM

reviews.title: Thermaltake - Versa H17 Micro ATX Mini Tower Case
reviews.comment: This Thermaltake case is just what I was looking for. I upgraded from a much larger case with a window and lighted fans to a much more sophisticated and minimalist look. This case keeps my system cool enough with 3 120mm fans in front 1 120mm fan on top and the 1 120mm fan in back that comes with the case. The case is sturdy and not flimsy and is easy to build an mATX build in. I have 2 SSD drives in the SSD spots and an HDD in a bottom spot.  I would buy this again.
reviews.author: STar
